title: refactor(ci): simplify workflows, split lint/test, bump actions and deps hygiene
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows: split lint and test pipelines, reduced matrix duplication, upgraded actions and Node version references, improved caching keys for workspace packages. No behavioral changes to runtime code. Expected to reduce CI runtime and flakiness.
description: Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflows had grown divergent and slow after incremental changes across repositories. This PR consolidates common steps, splits long-running lint jobs from test matrices, upgrades several GH Actions and Node references to sane defaults, and performs repo hygiene to remove deprecated workflow fragments. Goals: 1) Reduce CI runtime and queue contention for PRs by running lint fast and tests in parallelizable matrices. 2) Improve cache hit-rate across workspace packages. 3) Upgrade actions and drop obsolete step patterns to reduce security/maintenance burden. 4) Make release automation clearer and safer by separating the release workflow and adding an explicit approval gate. Summary of changes: - New workflows/.github/workflows/lint.yml (fast path for formatting, eslint, and types). - New workflows/.github/workflows/test.yml (split unit/integration matrix, Node 18/20 targets removed in favor of Node 20 single matrix to reduce duplication while keeping constraints). - Release workflow extracted to .github/workflows/release.yml with explicit manual approval and clearer tagging steps. - Consolidated shared workflow templates under .github/workflows/templates/ci-steps.yml and moved common cache and setup logic there. - Upgraded actions: actions/checkout@v4 -> v4 (minor config), actions/setup-node@v4 -> v4 pinned, cache/key improvements to use workspace hash and yarn lock version. - Minor package changes: trimmed devDependency duplicates in package.json at repo root and in redwood-sdk-typescript. - Added a small helper script scripts/ci/cache-key.sh used by workflows to compute stable cache keys for monorepo packages. - CI hygiene: removed legacy linux-legacy matrix entries and deprecated Fedora job. The description below covers commits, files changed highlights, review conversation, CI run notes, and merge details.

review_comments: Miguel Torres: Nice cleanup. Two questions: 1) Are we comfortable dropping Node 18 testing in all SDKs? 2) Can we avoid using workspace hash that includes CI secrets (I think current script is fine but double-check).

Asha Patel: For Node 18, we have a scheduled weekly compatibility job (ENG-8721) and support window notes in CONTRIBUTING.md; dropping from the PR matrix reduces runtime significantly. Cache-key script uses only package.json lockfile content and git tree hash; no secrets are included. I added a unit test for the script in this branch.
Lena Kim: Please ensure release.yml requires 'release-approver' team approval before publishing. Also add an explicit step to create a changelog artifact for auditing.
Asha Patel: Added approval gate (environment protection) and a changelog artifact step that uploads the generated notes to the workflow run summary.

Ravi Desai: CI flake I saw in integration was due to a timeout in the e2e step. Recommend increasing default timeout and adding a retry wrapper. Consider this a follow-up if we see flakes after this merge.
Asha Patel: Agree; opened ENG-8799 to track e2e retries and increased timeout in test.yml for integration jobs in this PR to mitigate immediate flakes.

notes_on_compatibility: Dropped Node 18 from PR-time matrices but kept a scheduled weekly Node 18 job and a compatibility tag for release verification. SDK teams informed and a migration guide added to CONTRIBUTING.md.
risk_and_rollback: Low-medium. Changes are CI and docs focused; no runtime behavior changes. Rollback plan: revert workflow changes and re-enable legacy workflows if downstream issues are observed. Revert PR created automatically by release manager script if required.
